card.name: Opening parenthesis before section numbers
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis (or the period in a number like 2.3) right after a cross-reference heading such as "see Dosage and Administration" or "Clinical Pharmacology", just before a section number.

modes.label: Cross-reference parenthesis
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a section title in a bracketed [see ...] reference, before the section number.

modes.label: Period inside section number
modes.description: The period inside a section number in a highlights list of dosage items.

card.writes: It promotes the word section in its various forms, suggesting a section number or reference comes next.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a label where a pointer to another numbered section is about to appear.
